summary: Confirmed all 30 requested global-diversity estimates against the supplied PDF after reading the complete markdown conversion, including all appendices and supplementary information (1,169 lines). All sources cited by these estimates were checked on PDF pp. 7, 21 and 22. Direct parsing of Table 11 (mean pairwise distance, PDF p. 21), Table 12 (median pairwise distance, PDF p. 22), and Table 13 (mean centroid distance, PDF p. 22) confirmed all 90 recorded numeric statistics: 30 signed differences, 30 Holm-Bonferroni-adjusted p-values, and 30 Cliff’s delta values. Each value belongs to the recorded outcome and ordered arm contrast; every numeric source quote matches its table row. The reported mechanical flags are false positives caused by trailing-zero formatting. For example, 1.21 equals the printed 1.210000, 0.31 equals 0.310000, and -0.61 equals -0.610000. The source quotes preserve the printed six-decimal precision. The question, construct, measure, unit, higher_is, outcome_with_ai, outcome_timing, within_person, comparison_type and se_basis codes are supported. These are immediate across_people diversity outcomes from SBERT distances between submitted human ideas, with higher values indicating more diversity. AI examples were available during production. Randomized within-person condition sequences support paired coding; no first-round-only estimates are reported. Control supplies human examples, supporting ai_vs_active; contrasts between AI configurations are ai_design. The analysis computes diversity on sampled idea sets and permutes paired set values by item and Monte Carlo seed, supporting unit=set and se_basis=set, rather than participant-level uncertainty. Analysis-specific people counts and total analyzed-set counts are not printed, so the null n_treatment, n_control, n_total and n_units fields are appropriate. The study-wide count of 844 people is not the count for each post-sixth-trial global analysis; the printed 50s describe Monte Carlo runs and ideas per sampled set. Numerical arm levels, SDs, SEs and confidence limits are not printed for these contrasts; Figure 7 cannot supply transcribed numerical values. The low-exposure condition label in the main-text discussion on PDF p. 8 conflicts with Table 12. The extraction explicitly notes that conflict and correctly follows its cited table: LowExposureDisclosed-Control has difference 0.470000 and delta 0.110000; LowExposureUndisclosed-Control has difference -0.610000 and delta -0.060000. Coverage review found all ten reported condition pairs for each of the three global metrics, including pairs changing both exposure and disclosure. The remaining outcome inventory and exclusions were checked for coverage under extraction rules 4-6; no additional eligible full-sample two-arm estimate was found missing. Numerical re-verification was restricted to the 30 requested estimates.
